prompt:
Recolour the attached map. Change ONLY fill colours. Do not move, redraw, add or delete any coastline, border or island, and do not touch any text.

The map is coloured by time zone, so several countries appear as two or more colours. Every country must be ONE flat solid colour across the whole of its territory.

IRAN, SAUDI ARABIA, TURKEY, IRAQ, EGYPT, PAKISTAN, AFGHANISTAN, KAZAKHSTAN, UZBEKISTAN, TURKMENISTAN and INDIA are each one single colour.

No two countries that share a border may have the same colour. UZBEKISTAN and TURKMENISTAN border each other and must differ. Spread the work across all nine of these: #FF0024 red, #009DFF blue, #00D200 green, #FFCC00 amber, #BEFF8F pale green, #75FFC8 mint, #51B8FF sky blue, #D9DAFF lavender, #FF8548 orange.

The Caspian Sea and the Black Sea are water and must stay their original colour with no land drawn in them. Keep the white lines between countries exactly as they are — do not draw black outlines. Keep every country name and city name where it is, and keep the flat pixel rendering with solid fills.
